contract.note: 屏幕空间平铺；地宫/迷宫的石板必须按 64×36 菱形格对齐，图块周期 256×144

prompts.default: Game environment raster asset. Rounded chunky hand-painted cartoon, soft dark purple-brown outlines, ONLY 2–3 clear flat shade levels, simple broad shapes, small brief highlights. Match chibi fantasy actors. NO photographic texture, noise, micro-detail, airbrush shading, black outlines, text, labels, frames or watermark. Materials: blue-gray block masonry with broad sparse moss patches; local palette: warm ivory limestone, pale tan earth, small blue crystals. Seamless walkable floor material, full bleed, uniform soft light, no directional cast shadows, no vignette, no walls or standing objects. A rectangular 16:9 seamlessly repeating pattern of uniform isometric diamond paving stones, exactly four 64x36 diamonds across a final 256x144 tile. All diamond slopes 32:18, orthographic 2:1 floor, thin muted mortar gaps. No 3D edges or base under the floor. Bright pale walkable ground, chibi actors remain clear.
